definitions.acceptance_override: strict gate status is diagnostic and does not exclude a model
definitions.averaging: uniform mean of the 20 per-model sigmoid probabilities
definitions.category_selection: maximum full-precision category Dice, then category hits, then lower threshold
definitions.global_selection: maximum full-precision overall Dice, then hits, then lower threshold

warnings: Seven models have failed strict reproduction records and are included by explicit user-approved diagnostic override.
Category 2f has no val200 findings, so its threshold and metrics are unavailable.
Rare-category thresholds are descriptive and unstable, especially category 2g with one finding.
Global and category thresholds are selected post hoc on val200 and do not establish test-set generalization.
